subject.title: feat(clients): adopt model controls, session management, and keyboard history recall on iOS

question: Should iOS now expose the shared advanced model and session-management surface as a supported parity feature, once the branch is rebased and live iOS behavior is shown?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing client capability expansion that changes how iOS users edit persistent session settings and create worktree sessions; the protected maintainer label signals that product and UX sponsorship should be explicit.

options.title: Sponsor the iOS parity surface
options.body: Confirm the iOS UX direction, require a clean rebase and redacted paired-Gateway proof, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only the agreed model or session subset and defer the remaining controls to a separately sponsored iOS follow-up.

options.title: Defer iOS adoption
options.body: Keep the shared primitives available but postpone host exposure until iOS product priorities are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the iOS parity surface
recommendation.body: Confirm the iOS UX direction, require a clean rebase and redacted paired-Gateway proof, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related PR history and this branch both place steipete closest to the shared native-chat and iOS adoption design.
